comparison.objective: Scrape adhered griddle debris over the plate lip into its grease tray without scattering or gouging.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain scraper-edge contact and angle, break adhered residue free, overlap strokes, and push fragments into a receiver.
comparison.success_condition: At least 98% of debris reaches the tray with minimal residue and loss, no damaging gouge, and the scraper is released and still.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record because both recover many pieces into a receiver and penalize spill, but scraping adhered residue with a tool does not test size-selective aperture passage while retaining larger workpieces in a lifted screen. All versions specify mass-based outcomes; threshold revisions do not create ambiguity.
